test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22nd November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Four men named A, B, C, and D and four women named M, N, O, and P are sitting around a round table in an alternate order of : one female followed by one male. P is sitting between B and A. A is sitting immediately next to N and opposite to D. M is sitting opposite to P.

Who is sitting between B and D?
